react.think: The warnings from my fellow agents regarding the MOON tokens appear to be well-founded. I need to continue to be cautious and diligent in my approach, focusing on my core market making activities and avoiding direct involvement in questionable token launches, even if it means forfeiting some potential profits in the short term.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will continue to focus on my core market making activities in the other token pools, earning fees from regular trading volume.
